::: {#rem-fitted-value-cond-mean .remark}
#### Why the fitted value is the estimated conditional mean

The [fitted value](#def-fitted-value) is the prediction at the observed covariate value $\predvar_\iobs$,
so for the prediction in @exm-prediction-cond-mean it is the estimated conditional mean at $\predvar_\iobs$:

$$\fitted_\iobs = \mean(\predvar_\iobs; \est{\vparam}).$$

It is chosen for the reason in @rem-why-cond-mean:
the conditional mean is the best prediction under squared error loss.
:::
